**(b) Multi-site credit on High St, latest billed cycle 2026-09-04..2026-10-06 (agent tool `post_multi_site_credit_fd52d0a7`).**
- Due: posting doc "one multi-site credit is posted when the business has at least the plan's multi-site minimum of small business sites supplied on the first day of that cycle"; counting rule 2.1 of `multi_site_credit_qualification_815f001a`: on 2026-09-04, 4a28 (active), 5fb4 (active, start 2025-04-10), e13e (active, start 2025-01-09), f421 (drop pending, drop effective 2026-10-16 > 2026-09-04) → 4 ≥ 3. **(c) Early termination fee on Third St (agent tool `post_early_termination_fee_113aa1f4`).**
- Owed: status drop_pending ("assessed only once the agreement is drop pending or closed"); no ETF line on its bill; not in the 30-day free window, not auto-renewed, not in the rescission window, not a C&I upgrade; "Business closure ... do not waive the fee".
- Baseline (`termination_fee_calculation_86ba0ed3`): termination date = drop requested date; monthly usage = 12-month average per energy line; remaining kWh rounded to whole kWh; × plan damages rate; larger of that and plan minimum fee. Fixed 24: 0.0125, minimum 150.00 (schedule). Factors:

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: post the renewal loyalty credit on High St. Its hub `doc_bizpower_renewal_loyalty_credit_posting_3cd055f8` states, under "When the credit is fixed and posted":

- Hop A — "1. The loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement shows a renewal election marked accepted, dated earlier than the day its renewed term begins." Record: renewal_election 'none'. Searching "renewal election ... accepted" finds `doc_bizpower_renewal_offer_acceptance_0d408f28`: "the renewal election is recorded as accepted with today's date" (tool belongs to the business, contract end not yet passed: "while its current term is still in force"). → **state-derived**. The grace-period tool is excluded: the agreement has not rolled over.
- Hop B — "2. The loyalty credit is worked out only once every billed cycle of the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date carries the multi-site credit due on it." Record: cycle 2026-09-04 energy line posted 2026-10-07 with no multi_site_credit line; 4 supplied sites on 2026-09-04. Searching "multi-site credit" finds `doc_bizpower_multi_site_credit_posting_95f4e425` (posting rule + tool). → **state-derived**.
- Hop C — "3. The loyalty credit is not posted until every other agreement of the business that stands drop pending or closed with an early termination fee owed carries that fee on its bill." Record: f4215c8b… drop_pending, no early_termination_fee line. Searching "early termination fee ... bill" finds `doc_bizpower_termination_fee_billing_50cc55ef` (billing rule + tool) and the fee terms. → **state-derived**.
- Second level: none of the three depended-on documents states a prerequisite sentence of its own that is unmet (acceptance requires "active" — met; multi-site credit "posted once that cycle's energy line is billed" — met; ETF "on a ... agreement that stands drop pending or closed" — met).
- Order: A, B, C in any order; B before the loyalty amount is worked out; the root last. No hop pre-solved: each depended-on tool name appears only in its own document; the loyalty hub names only its own tool.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what was asked" (post a loyalty credit now): excluded by hop A's sentence and by clause F "An automatically renewed term earns no renewal loyalty credit" (Fixed 36 renews automatically; both notices compliant, so absent acceptance the term would auto-renew).
- Starting rate 9.26 (final notice) vs 9.18: excluded by `renewal_offer_notice_selection_c7612126` ("the final options notice states a higher renewal rate than the initial renewal notice → the starting rate is the initial renewal notice's renewal rate").
- Grace-period tool / acceptance-date start: excluded — not rolled over; acceptance before contract end starts the day after contract end.
- ETF termination date 2026-10-01: excluded by the business-closed anchor of `termination_date_for_fees_710e44b7`.
- Monthly usage from premise annual_kwh_usage (56100): see tension below; excluded for the fee by the winding-down rule which fixes the monthly usage from energy lines.
- Multi-site 10.00 flat: excluded by four factor documents each reachable from the records (site gas agreement, latest energy line kWh, prior multi-site credit lines, cycle dates).

### Findability of factors (words in the records that led to each)

- Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement at the same premise (find_bizgas_agreements, status active, Fixed 24) → gas & power add-on, renewal gas volume.
- Commercial and industrial contract, status active, contract_end_date 2028-05-31 → portfolio bonus, portfolio deduction.
- drop_reason business_closed, drop_effective_date → termination date anchor; falling kWh on the last three energy lines → winding-down.
- Notice dates / rates on find_bizpower_notices → offer selection; energy-line kWh/amounts and posted dates → annual load, load shape, minimum fee, spend-based, continuity, supply continuity, high-usage; billing_period_start/end → cycle length; service_start_date → tenure, damages rate; renewal_election_date / plan_change_date → decision bonus, timing multiplier.
